guidance.claim: Maruti Suzuki expects volume growth of over 10% this year compared to last year.
guidance.quote: The broad expectation , which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year.
guidance.speaker: Rahul Bharti

guidance.claim: The company plans to increase production capacity to 4 million units per annum.
guidance.quote: Besides, the company has put plans in place to increase the production capacity to 4 million units per annum in the medium term.
guidance.speaker: Rahul Bharti

guidance.claim: The company is looking at a INR 14,000 crores capex for the full year.
guidance.quote: Overall, on the capex for FY 26-27, we are looking at a INR 14,000 crores capex for the full year.
guidance.speaker: Arnab Roy

guidance.claim: The company aims to enable a network of over 1 lakh charging points across India by 2030.
guidance.quote: Aligned with Suzuki's global vision, we plan to introduce multiple EVs and to support this, our aim is to enable a network of over 1 lakh charging points across India by 2030, along with our dealers and charge point operators.
guidance.speaker: Rahul Bharti

guidance.claim: Additional volume of about 250,000 cars will be available this year over previous year.
guidance.quote: Effectively, one can expect that we'll have an additional volume of about 250,000 cars available th is year over the previous year.
guidance.speaker: Rahul Bharti

reported.claim: Recorded highest ever annual sales of 2.42 million vehicles including 447,000 exports.
reported.quote: First, the company recorded its highest ever annual sales of 2.42 million vehicles, which includes the highest ever export of 447,000 vehicles.
reported.speaker: Rahul Bharti

reported.claim: Recorded highest ever quarterly sales of 676,209 units, up 11.8% year-on-year.
reported.quote: The company recorded its highest ever quarterly sales of 676,209 units, up 11.8% from quarter 4 of the previous financial year.
reported.speaker: Rahul Bharti

reported.claim: Achieved record net sales of about INR 500.79 billion in Q4.
reported.quote: During this period, the company achieved record net sales of about INR 500.79 billion compared to about INR388.39 billion in the same period a year ago.
reported.speaker: Rahul Bharti

reported.claim: Operating profit EBIT increased by 30.4% reaching an all-time high over INR44 billion.
reported.quote: Operating profit, EBIT for quarter 4 of this year increased by 30.4% over quarter 4 of the previous financial year, reaching an all - time high of over INR44 billion.
reported.speaker: Rahul Bharti

reported.claim: Net profit declined by 6.9% year-on-year to nearly INR36 billion.
reported.quote: Despite the growth in operating profit, net profit declined by 6.9% year-on-year to nearly INR36 billion, primarily due to mark-to-market impact, which my colleague, Arnab, will explain in his part.
reported.speaker: Rahul Bharti

reported.claim: Operating profit margin EBIT expanded to 8.8% of net sales sequentially.
reported.quote: Sequentially, the operating profit margin EBIT has expanded to 8.8% of net sales compared to 8.1% in quarter 3 of the financial year.
reported.speaker: Rahul Bharti
